entries.description: A 40-acre farm in Shelby, Michigan, owned and worked by one lesbian. It has housing, cold running water, electricity, woods, farmland, a 1-acre garden, and animals. She welcomes visitors and campers, including lesbian women, non-lesbian women, girl and boy children, and gay and non-gay men if known to her or accompanied by women.
entries.raw_text: JAN F WALSH Two Towers, 201 S 132nd Ave, Shelby, MI 49455 (616)861-4939. I own a farm, live on it and work it somewhat. I raise animals and have a 1 acre garden. I welcome visitors, especially lesbians as I am quite isolated, but I do not forbid males of any age access IF known to me or with wimmin. There is camping space galore. If the visit is over 1 night I ask for a $2 fee (I trade)/night per person to defray my costs (water, toilet paper, produce, etc). Drugs in moderation are fine. No proselytizing please. Extended visits (over 1 week) need to be decided in person. I welcome: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, (males). I have/am: 1 lesbian, 40 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing (cold running water only)/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land ('I own a farm, live on it', '1 lesbian'). Land address inferred from street address where owner lives ('live on it'). Acreage is 40 ('40 acres'; '1 acre garden' is part of the farm). Residents is 1 ('live on it', '1 lesbian'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women ('especially lesbians'), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children and Boy children ('girl and boy children'), Gay men and Non-gay men ('(males)', 'males of any age access IF known to me or with wimmin'). Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency ('I own a farm, live on it and work it somewhat. I raise animals and have a 1 acre garden'). Note that 'Drugs in moderation are fine' is not a substance-free rule.

entries.description: An 80-acre cooperative farm and campground in West Central Wisconsin with 175 members (almost all lesbians) and 4 year-round women residents. The land has woods, hayfields, an orchard, a garden, berries, permanent structures, plumbing, electricity, and some chemical-free camping space. Welcomes new members and residents, lesbian and non-lesbian women, girl children, and boy children until age 2.
entries.raw_text: WISCONSIN WOMYN'S LAND CO-OP Rt 2 Box 42, Norwalk, WI 54648 (608)269-5301. WWLC owns DOE (Daughters of Earth) Farm; half wooded campground, half hayfield, orchard, garden, berries, etc in West Central Wisconsin. The land is hilly, secluded, very beautiful. Four womyn live here year 'round, more in summer. Some of the campground chemical free space. Camping equipment available if needed. Sliding scale fees. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, boy children 'til age of 2, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 175 members almost all lesbians, 80 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative ('CO-OP', 'Four womyn live here year 'round', '175 members'). Land address copied from rural route mailing address ('Rt 2 Box 42, Norwalk, WI 54648'). Residents is 4 ('Four womyn live here year 'round'; 'more in summer' and '175 members' are not year-round resident counts). Accepted groups: Lesbian women (questionnaire directory, '175 members almost all lesbians'), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children ('girl children'), Boy children ('boy children 'til age of 2'). Focuses: Environmentalism/eco-friendly ('Some of the campground chemical free space').

entries.description: Two lesbians living on 80 acres of chemical-free land with woods, farmland, housing, plumbing, electricity, and primitive camping. They hope to build a community focused on interdependent care and healing. Open to lesbian and non-lesbian women, disabled women, and girl and boy children by arrangement; no men, pets, or guns.
entries.raw_text: THE WEB c/o Lanning, Box 8742, Minneapolis, MN 55408 (612)983-2289. We are consciously creating a space in which to live our lesbian reality in harmony with the natural world. Primitive camping here is open to wimmin. We hope to build a community focused on interdependent care toward the healing and health of us all. Chemically free, no pets, no guns, no men. We welcome: girl and boy children by arrangement, differently abled. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 80 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule ('2 lesbians', 'women living on the land'; 'We hope to build a community' expresses a hope rather than active recruitment of new resident members on the welcome list). Mailing address is a PO Box ('Box 8742, Minneapolis, MN 55408'), so land street, city, and zip are left blank; land_state is inferred as MN from mailing state. Residents is 2 ('2 lesbians', 'women living on the land'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women and Non-lesbian women (pre-1986 'Primitive camping here is open to wimmin'), Girl children and Boy children ('girl and boy children by arrangement'). Focuses: Environmentalism/eco-friendly ('Chemically free'), Disabled women ('We welcome: ... differently abled', 'focused on interdependent care toward the healing and health of us all').

entries.description: A 40-acre vacation ranch in Ronan, Montana, run by 2 resident lesbians. Offers tipi lodgings, campsites, food service, hot tub, and sports facilities for lesbian women, non-lesbian women, gay men, and girl and boy children, with some weeks for women only.
entries.raw_text: NORTH CROW VACATION RANCH RR 1, Box 62-A, Ronan, MT 59864 (406)676-5169. A new social alternative for lesbians and gay men on holiday. Tipi lodgings ($11/night) or campsite ($7/night). Some weeks are for womyn only. We provide food service ($11/night), hot tub, sports facilities, firewood and basic conveniences. Close by: swimming, boating, etc. Reservations preferred. We welcome: girl and boy children, gay males. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 40 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space ('VACATION RANCH', 'for lesbians and gay men on holiday', tipi lodgings and campsites). Land address copied from rural route mailing address ('RR 1, Box 62-A, Ronan, MT 59864'). Residents is 2 ('2 lesbians', 'women living and working on the land'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women ('for lesbians'), Non-lesbian women (pre-1986 'Some weeks are for womyn only'), Girl children and Boy children ('girl and boy children'), Gay men ('gay men', 'gay males').

entries.description: Four lesbians holding 90 acres of woods, meadows, rocky bluffs, a creek, and springs, with camping space. No one lives on the land yet; long-term plans include building cabins for personal use and visiting women, farming, solar and appropriate technology, and nurturing the female principle. Welcomes new members and residents, as well as visiting lesbian and non-lesbian women by pre-arrangement.
entries.raw_text: REBECCA, SUSAN, ANNE & MAURINE 4026 Anderson SE, Albuquerque, NM 87108 (505)268-1863. The land is a combination of woods, meadows, and rocky bluffs. We have a creek and springs. Long-term plans include: cabins for our personal use, additional cabins and camping sites for use by visiting women (by pre-arrangement only), and some farming. Emphasis on solar and appropriate technology and on developing a place that nurtures the female principle. We welcome: new members/resident. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 90 acres, camping space, woods.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative (4 lesbians who own 90 acres together and welcome 'new members/resident'). Contact name is the four women's names heading the listing. Mailing address is a city street in Albuquerque while cabins for personal use are only in 'Long-term plans' and 'We have/are' lists no housing or women living on the land, so num_residents is 0 and land_street_address, land_city, and land_zip are left blank; land_state inferred as NM. Accepted groups: Lesbian women ('4 lesbians', 'We welcome: new members/resident') and Non-lesbian women (pre-1986 'visiting women'). Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency ('Long-term plans include: ... some farming'), Environmentalism/eco-friendly ('Emphasis on solar and appropriate technology'), Spirituality/ritual ('developing a place that nurtures the female principle').

entries.description: A women's land collective with 167 acres of woods, meadows, grazing farmland, and camping space two hours north of San Francisco. Six lesbians are involved; the old group (except one) needs to sell, and they are seeking 2 lesbian-feminists and loans for a new group focused on building living space, relationships, and feminism, and not into drug abuse or S&M.
entries.raw_text: YORKVILLE WOMEN'S LAND COLLECTIVE c/o Annie, 50 Balmy, San Francisco, CA 94110 (415)285-5145. YWLC seeking 2 lesbian-feminists for new group. Old group (save one) needs to sell. Lots of land 2 hours north of SF. Needs committment, money and respect. Into building living space, relationship, feminism. Not into drug abuse or S&M. Send name, address and phone for full details. Issues & money still negotiable. We welcome: new members, loans. We have/are: 6 lesbians, 167 acres, camping space, woods and meadows, farm land (grazing).
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative ('COLLECTIVE', '6 lesbians, 167 acres', 'seeking 2 lesbian-feminists for new group'). Mailing address is in San Francisco while land is '2 hours north of SF' and community name gives Yorkville, so land_city is Yorkville and land_state is CA. Residents left blank because 'We have/are: 6 lesbians' does not say 'women living on the land' and they are 'Into building living space'. Accepted groups: Lesbian women ('seeking 2 lesbian-feminists', '6 lesbians'). Focuses: Recovery/substance-free ('Not into drug abuse'). Also rejects S&M ('Not into drug abuse or S&M').

entries.land_location_as_stated: creek on land, near Russian River
entries.description: Privately woman-owned 500-acre land near the Russian River in California, with woods, farmland, a creek, camping space, outhouses, plumbing, and permanent structures limited to workers. Open to camping and events from June to September, with horse boarding and workers welcomed. Welcomes new members, lesbian and non-lesbian women, girl children, and boy children under 10.
entries.raw_text: THE RANCH c/o Helen Wagner, 440 Holladay, San Francisco, CA 94110 (415)824-5352. Privately Woman owned land open to camping and events June-Sept. Horses boarded, workers welcomed. Daily and weekly rates and special event rates $5/day and up. We welcome: new members, girl children, boy children under 10, nonlesbian women, dogs, horses. We have/are: 500 acres, housing/permanent structures limited to workers, plumbing, outhouses, camping space, woods, farm land, cook out grills, creek on land, near Russian River, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land ('Privately Woman owned land'). Mailing address is in San Francisco while land is 'near Russian River', so land_street_address, land_city, and land_zip are left blank; land_state is CA. Residents is blank because no count is given alongside 'women living and working on the land'. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (questionnaire directory), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children ('girl children'), Boy children ('boy children under 10').

entries.land_location_as_stated: close to the ocean; redwood-covered slopes, open grassy meadows, waterfalls, and pools for reflection
entries.description: A women's community and retreat in Elk, California, close to the ocean, with 8 lesbians living and working on the land. It has redwood slopes, meadows, waterfalls, vegetable, flower, and herb gardens, an orchard, and 9 or 10 structures including a communal kitchen, guesthouse, and bath house. Began as an older women's community and now seeks permanent members (especially lesbians over 50) and welcomes visitors (with fee exceptions for working-class, older, and third world women), girl children, and possibly non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: LAVENDER HILL 1085 Greenwood Rd, Elk, AC 95432. A thriving womyn's community and retreat located 3 hours north of SF and close to the ocean. 160 acres of redwood-covered slopes, open grassy meadows, waterfalls, and pools for reflection. Nine structures including a communal kitchen, guesthouse, and bath house, look out over surrounding valleys and hills. A vegetable and flower garden, an herb garden, and an orchard. We began as an older womyn's community. We are now womyn of diverse ages, races and backgrounds, looking for permanent members (especially lesbians over 50). Visitors $5/night (exceptions: working class/older/third world women). We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women (possibly). We have/are: 8 lesbians, 60 acres, 10 housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity with generator, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative ('A thriving womyn's community and retreat' — community is named first). State typo 'AC' corrected to 'CA' in contact_state and land_state. Land address copied from road address ('1085 Greenwood Rd, Elk, CA 95432'). Acreage gives two figures: '160 acres' in text and '60 acres' in 'We have/are:'; stored smaller figure 60 per codebook rule. Structures also gives 'Nine structures' in text and '10 housing/permanent structures' in 'We have/are:'. Residents is 8 ('8 lesbians', 'women living and working on the land'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women ('especially lesbians over 50', '8 lesbians'), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women (possibly)', plus pre-1986 'womyn'), Girl children ('girl children'). Focuses: Older women ('began as an older womyn's community', 'looking for permanent members (especially lesbians over 50)', visitor fee exception for 'older'), Working-class women (visitor fee exception for 'working class'), Women of color ('womyn of diverse ages, races and backgrounds', visitor fee exception for 'third world women').
